reference_sql:
WITH first_visits AS (
  -- one row per first_visit event of 1 to 15 December 2025 (Dublin days): only the columns the count needs
  SELECT traffic_source.source AS source, traffic_source.medium AS medium
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'first_visit'
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251201' AND '20251215'
)
SELECT source, medium, COUNT(*) AS first_visits
FROM first_visits
GROUP BY source, medium

WITH first_visits AS (

  SELECT traffic_source.source AS source, traffic_source.medium AS medium
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'first_visit'
    AND CAST(strptime(event_date, '%Y%m%d') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-01' AND DATE '2025-12-15'
)
SELECT source, medium, COUNT(*) AS first_visits
FROM first_visits
GROUP BY source, medium
